title: Global Haptics Manager and Pattern Map
description:
Purpose: Centralize haptic patterns and provide a simple publish API for other mechanics. Patterns: light hover pulse, sharp bolt fire, heavy construct form, rhythmic charge at station, strong block impact, sprint start/end, flight boost/evade. Intensity scales with construct weight and user settings.

API (via ECS singleton or service):
- Publish(pattern_id: string, hand: left/right/both, intensity_scale: float=1.0, duration_s: optional)
- Patterns: hover_light, bolt_fire_sharp, construct_form_heavy, recharge_rhythm, block_impact_strong, sprint_start, sprint_end, flight_boost, evade_burst.

Controls: N/A (consumed by other mechanics). Settings: reads haptic intensity from Accessibility/Settings.

Components:
- Reads: user settings via CComfortState/CAccessibilitySettings.
- Writes: CHapticsEvent to device.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_haptics_mapping validates pattern presence.

Integration:
- Other generated tasks depend_on this manager.

Scenes: Global.

Suggested file split: haptics_register.cpp, haptics_patterns.cpp, haptics_service.cpp.
